notes: Quantinuum expanding to Singapore with new R&D Centre, partnering with Singapore National Quantum Office. Helios system to be installed in Singapore in 2026 -- first international deployment outside the US. Will support research in pharmaceuticals, materials science, and finance. Quantinuum also planning IPO (confidential filing January 2026). Helios specs unchanged from Nov 2025 launch: 98 qubits, 99.9975% 1Q fidelity, 99.921% 2Q fidelity, 94 error-detected logical qubits.
